description: PRD spine for Initiative 0002 (Quick Start Engine): deterministic-ish WDK run that produces three evidence-backed artefacts (B-I tracker, B-II exceptions table, reconciliation issues list) under evidence-first + fail-closed invariants. Implementation proceeds via numbered slice PRDs in the dossier.

userStories.title: Run skeleton + version pinning + incremental progress surface
userStories.description: Start a Quick Start run on indexed/ready folders, pin versions (index_version, agent_bundle_version, question_set_version), stream progress/rows via canonical APIs, and enforce strict row invariants.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /folders/:id/runs enforces preconditions (folders.state in {indexed, ready}) and returns safe errors via the standard error envelope with trace_id.
Run records pin index_version, agent_bundle_version, and question_set_version; workflow/step boundaries follow WDK directives ('use workflow' / 'use step').
UI reads run progress via GET /runs/:id and rows via GET /folders/:id/report?run_id=... (no direct DB reads).
Unique (run_id, question_id) is enforced; restarts do not duplicate rows; step idempotency is via deterministic step_key.

userStories.title: List payload contract + artefact table rendering
userStories.description: Decide and implement a versioned list payload contract for B-I/B-II/issues with stable item_id and item-level citation_ids; UI renders artefact tables from structured payload without inventing new report-row statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: Payload storage approach is explicit and versioned (payload_schema_version) and does not turn provenance_json into a product contract.
Items have stable item_id for diffing/idempotency and include item-level citation_ids for claimed fields; unsupported fields are downgraded (no fabrication).
Report-row statuses remain terminal-only: needs_review|reviewed|missing_input|citation_failed; item-level states do not reuse row statuses.
API exposes citation_ids and payload needed for UI rendering; UI renders from locked citations only (no chunk IDs).

userStories.title: Commitment parsing baseline (pack_01_clean) for B-I and B-II
userStories.description: Extract B-I requirements and B-II exceptions from the commitment for pack_01_clean and match truth key fields with lockable citations and zero false positives.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_01_clean, B-I payload matches truth/expected_requirements_tracker.csv on key fields (item count + item numbering at minimum).
For pack_01_clean, B-II payload matches truth/expected_exceptions_table.csv on key fields (item count + item numbering + normalised instrument refs where present).
Precision rule: 0 false positives (no extra items not present in truth by item number).
Candidate citations are chunk IDs; citations are locked and immutable; verification is fail-closed with taxonomy reason codes.

userStories.title: Exception -> instrument matching baseline + missing-doc journey (pack_02_missing_rea)
userStories.description: Match exception items to instrument PDFs deterministically, surface ambiguity and missing docs/attachments explicitly, and prevent silent auto-picks or fabricated summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_01_clean, exception items with truth-linked instruments resolve to match_status=matched with citations supporting the match.
Ambiguous matches surface as match_status=ambiguous with candidates listed; no silent auto-pick; row remains needs_review.
For pack_02_missing_rea, missing exception doc is surfaced as match_status=missing_doc with an actionable missing-doc checklist.
Missing attachments are surfaced explicitly and do not result in fabricated exhibit summaries; the reference clause is cited.

userStories.title: Survey extraction baseline + certification gap issue (pack_03_mismatch_and_cert_gap)
userStories.description: Extract certification parties and baseline callouts with citations, and flag certification gaps as a structured issue code with evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Survey extraction yields structured certification parties and baseline callouts for pack_01_clean where truth supports them, each backed by lockable citations.
For pack_03_mismatch_and_cert_gap, missing lender is flagged as a machine-readable issue code with citation to the certification block.
On scan/low-quality behavior where no citations can be locked, the row is missing_input with the exact answer string, zero citations, and a remediation checklist.
Model calls (draft/verify/embed) go through AI SDK (gateway default) and step boundaries record telemetry metadata safely.

userStories.title: Reconciliation issues list honesty policy (unknown bias)
userStories.description: Generate reconciliation issues with an explicit evidence threshold policy that biases to unknown rather than incorrect not_depicted claims.
acceptanceCriteria: Reconciliation items use item-level classification depicted|not_depicted|unknown; not_depicted requires positive evidence of absence (narrowly defined and cited).
When evidence is weak, items are downgraded to unknown and the report row remains needs_review (no hallucinations).
Issue drawer guidance explains what evidence is missing and what to do next; failure modes are explicit (no silent failures).
Verification is fail-closed and reason codes align with the failure taxonomy (e.g. ENTAILMENT_FAIL, CITATION_MISMATCH).
